facts: The frozen native SDK classifies TOOL_CALLS, CONTENT, REASONING_ONLY, EMPTY from message fields. The dispatch branch does not distinguish finish_reason=length.
Every REASONING_ONLY or EMPTY response is persisted as an agent message, followed by the same user-role corrective nudge. This ordinary SDK step is not the bounded v062 stuck_correction opportunity.
The v057 response projection preserves reasoning in the internal SDK message/event. Exported Qwen chat input uses the native SDK format_messages_for_llm serializer.
Qwen SDK model label openai/Qwen3.5-9B does not match SEND_REASONING_CONTENT_MODELS; serializer therefore omits the reasoning_content field on subsequent chat requests.

This means persisted reasoning provenance is not equivalent to replayed input. In a reasoning-only length-limited response, the next model call cannot continue from that text merely because it is in stored events.

sample_confirmation.related_201_usage_and_202_recovery: Sibling qwen_bottleneck_audit derives structure from the request/usage original, including 201 length=32768 reasoning-only and 202 tool_calls; cite its final artifact.

interpretation.supported: A concrete, repeatable path can spend a full 32768-token response without an action and then add generic corrective feedback while omitting the truncated reasoning text from subsequent chat input. This is native reasoning-model adaptation behavior, not PROJECT member/submit contamination.
not_established: It is not proved to be a permanent loop; the paired observed next response returned tool_calls.
No causal aggregate share of task latency or score loss is established by this static audit.
Replaying all prior reasoning or enlarging output is not assumed to be a valid fix; model-template semantics and resource conditions would need a separately identified validation.
